ui.intro: CCViewer is a free, open-source Claude Code viewer for the .jsonl session files stored under ~/.claude/projects/. Use it as a Claude Code session viewer to replay any conversation, or as a JSONL history viewer to audit tool calls, thinking blocks, token usage and cost — everything is rendered locally in your browser, and files never leave your computer.

ui.q1: How do I view previous Claude Code sessions?
ui.a1: Claude Code saves every session as a JSONL file under ~/.claude/projects/<project>/<session-id>.jsonl. Drop a single file or the whole project folder here to browse the full conversation.
ui.q2: Is my session file uploaded anywhere?
ui.a2: No. Session files are parsed and rendered locally without upload. On the hosted site, optional Microsoft Clarity analytics records public pages only after consent; recording stops before local sessions are displayed. Offline copies do not load analytics.
ui.a3: This Claude Code JSONL viewer supports Markdown rendering for user and assistant messages, extended thinking blocks, tool call parameters and results, images, token usage and cost stats — with an interface in 10 languages.
ui.a4: JSON Lines — one independent JSON object per line. Claude Code logs every message, tool call and metadata entry as a line.
ui.a5: Yes, it is free and open-source. No sign-up required.
